rationale: Hapax in this corpus. From root ⲧⲱⲛ 'rise' (cf. ⲧⲱⲛⲉ̄ 'the Rising' in glossary). Function as topic-marker at chapter opening parallel to other 'concerning the X' formulations. May alternatively be a scribal variant for ⲡⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ ('the Calling') or for an unattested cosmic technical term. Confidence low; flag for parallels.

Obscure noun in line 27 introducing the fourth member of the kephalaion's letter-typology. Most plausible: Lyc. variant for ⲡⲓⲥⲧⲟⲗⲏ < ⲉⲡⲓⲥⲧⲟⲗⲏ 'this letter' with ⲝ for ⲥⲧ (parenthetic letter pattern); supported by parallel ϩⲱϩ ⲁⲛ ⲧⲉ 'too is it' in line 30 echoing the explicit letter-affirmations of lines 4, 11, 22. Alternative: from ⲥⲧⲟ 'return, turn back' — naming the responsive letter from Church to Christ. Confidence low.
Lyc. plural form; cf. accumulated ⲙⲗⲟⲟϩ / ⲙ̄ⲗⲁϩ 'strife/quarrel' in glossary. Used here for the cosmic conflicts the molding-of-man underwent.
Probable qualitative-passive of ⲥϩⲁⲓ 'write' with ⲛⲏⲩⲧ ending of unclear function (possibly Lyc. plural-stative or fused 3pl). Cf. ⲥⲏϩ in adjacent context (lines 6, 13, 23, 31). Confidence moderate.
Causative-infinitive of ⲟⲩⲱϩ 'add, place upon' (cf. ϩⲟⲩⲱⲍ 'to add' in glossary). The 'preparation to be added' = future events still to be inscribed in the cosmic letter.
